item.title: Father, 4 children drown in heroic rescue attempt in Bakau
item.description: The tragedy unfolded before his wives and other family members, leaving the entire community in shock and disbelief. Kebba Wada, proprietor of Al-Furqan Institute, was widely known as a devoted servant of Islam, a compassionate father, and a pillar of the Bakau community.

item.title: GOMA urges withdrawal of Accreditation Policy and Online Content Regulation
item.description: These mechanisms are not incidental; they are the result of hard-earned reforms and reflect internationally recognised best practices. The proposed policy and regulations would effectively dismantle this framework and transfer its core functions to state-controlled structures, raising legitimate concerns about independence and balance.

item.title: Missing Jammeh assets report tabled before Assembly
item.description: Presenting before the House, chairperson of the Special Select Committee, Hon. Abdoulie Ceesay, said that on 10 May 2026 the Committee had been delegated the responsibility to consider recommendations arising from its report and to bring forward appropriate resolutions for the Assembly’s consideration.

item.title: Barrow commissions $12M ‘Barra Ferry’ in new era of green transport
item.description: The commissioning ceremony drew thousands of Gambians, eager to witness what many hailed as a groundbreaking milestone in President Adama Barrow’s administration—a promise made, and now delivered. The vessel carried jubilant passengers who celebrated the smooth, efficient crossing.
